thread:
Anika: quick thought — when folks save a console view that is scoped to a route+model combo, can we surface a tiny 'quota preview' and routing hint in the save modal? :eyes:
Cheng: re: api — current endpoint is POST /api/v1/savedquery with {name, filters, scope}. adding anything routing-specific will need a backwards-compatible field.
Rob: +1 to optional field. proposal: add optional routing_meta: {preferred_route, model_pin, route_tier} in the payload. leave old clients working.
Sara (UX): users consistently ask 'how much will this cost' before saving. an inline token estimate + a tiny sparkline for latency buckets would be ideal. minimal UI — don't want to slow the modal.
Anika: sketch for preview call: POST /api/telemetry/preview with payload {"filters":..., "model":"<pin>", "route":"<name>"} -> returns {token_estimate, latency_p50,p95}. show estimate and a 'why?' tooltip.
Cheng: that preview could be expensive if we run it on every modal open. suggestion: debounce 1.5s OR run only on explicit "estimate" button. also cache by (filters hash, model, route) for ~5m.
Rob: server-side limits needed too. preview should be a low-privilege, sampled path; fail-open: if preview errors, show "estimate unavailable" but still allow save. also redact private model details in the preview response.
Sara (UX): agree on fail-open. Also want a small affordance to persist routing hints so that saved view can auto-route requests in the console when opened. that would require the routing_meta persisted.
Anika: example saved payload (backcompat):
```
POST /api/v1/savedquery
{
  "name":"Payments - high-err-rate (model pinned)",
  "filters":[{"field":"status","op":"eq","value":"500"}],
  "scope":"route",
  "routing_meta": { "preferred_route":"payments-us-east", "model_pin":"redwood-quant-4bit" }
}
```
Cheng: small API nit — prefer snake_case for server: routing_meta -> routing_meta is fine but document invariant. also add a version field on savedquery so we can evolve.
Rob: security note: make sure routing_meta can't be used to escalate to restricted clusters. enforce that server-side by checking tenant mapping.
TelemetryBot: heads-up: if we add preview calls we should track preview_count metric and quota_preview_error_rate. current telemetry pipeline can handle ~500RPS of small preview calls but needs a sampling flag.
Anika: good call. Let's prot the flow: UI: debounce + show cached estimate if available, explicit 'refresh estimate' button. Backend: new telemetry/preview endpoint (sampled + auth) + optional routing_meta field on savedquery. document in API changelog.
Sara (UX): I'll mock the modal with the small meter and a fallback state. sharing in #design by EOD.
Cheng: i'll draft the API contract and add migration notes. Rob, can you check infra constraints for sampled preview path?
Rob: will ping infra. quick note — if we route-by-saved routing_meta, we might also want a UI affordance to 'ignore saved routing' for cross-route troubleshooting.
Anika: yep. final: save still generic; routing_meta is a hint, not enforced override by default.
Sara (UX): :thumbsup: prototyping now.
